answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the Jade Quorum Mechanism offers resilience against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to demonstrate unique computational capabilities, akin to cracking a quartz-based cryptographic puzzle. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities, like a comet hurtling towards a planet, would be forced to expend computational resources to create and maintain the fictional agents, thereby compromising their own resources and rendering the attack futile.
